title: Khor Virap, the pit where Gregory the Illuminator survived thirteen years #Armenia
description:
Facing Mount Ararat, Khor Virap is the foremost holy site of Christian Armenia. Brought out of its pit, Gregory the Illuminator healed Tiridates III, who proclaimed Christianity the state religion in 301.
